ranges.role: Klein joins the Tingen Nighthawks, trains as a Beyonder, forms his foundational team relationships, and remains defined by the Blackthorn tragedy after his resurrection.
Klein creates and hosts the gray-fog gathering as The Fool, operates The World as his proxy, grows the club into a high-level network, and leaves commissions before his slumber.
Klein serves through the Nighthawks under the Church of Evernight.
The Evernight side repeatedly becomes a crucial covert ally in Klein's high-sequence survival, advancement and resistance against the Celestial Worthy.

name: Sea God believers / Church of the Sea God

ranges.role: After Kalvetua's death Klein inherits the prayer network through the Sea God Scepter; the Rorsted believers later become one of his important anchor communities.

Klein encounters True Creator corruption, Lanevus and the Tingen descent plot, Mr. A and later high-level True Creator-linked actors; the relationship ultimately connects to the ancient sun god/Sasrir revelation.
Klein's cooperation with Sharron and Maric places him against Rose School pursuers; the conflict later escalates through Suah, the Chained God faction and Reinette Tinekerr.
Rosago's information supplies key Seer-pathway formulas, while Zaratul later becomes Klein's principal same-pathway rival for advancement and Sefirah Castle.
Adam enters Klein's progression directly at Ince's end, later reveals hidden arrangements around Utopia, Amon and the Great Old One succession struggle.
